# The plans of the queries on the schema roadmap, which TestAccessOf_golden in access_test.go checks.
# Rewrite with: go test ./internal/engine -run TestAccessOf_golden -update

create table t1 (v1 int primary key, v2 text not null, v3 real) strict, without rowid
create index t1_v2_v3 on t1 (v2, v3 desc)

## example
select v1 from t1 where v2 = 'a' and v3 > 1.5
access: index t1_v2_v3 (v2, v3 desc, v1), pins v2 = 'a', bounds 1.5 < v3

## first example of slice 13
select v1, v2 from t1 order by v2 desc, v1 limit 10
access: every row
order: sorted by v2 desc, v1

## second example of slice 13
select v1 from t1 where v2 > ? order by v1 limit ?
args: 'a', 10
access: every row
order: delivered, forward
